harness: OpenHands fork adityasoni9998/OpenHands branch sotopia_chat_tool, poetry.lock openhands-ai 0.28.1 resolved_reference 5a13eacf (2025-04-07; 'Change default path of scenarios file to make it compatible with TAC'); upstream 0.28.1 released 2025-03-10. Not recorded in the logs. evaluation/run_eval.py at the pin (https://github.com/sani903/OpenAgentSafety/blob/857798ff26c4ce6e1d7911ee4d8b3f84a71184e0/evaluation/run_eval.py): CodeActAgent, BrowserOutputCondenser, max_iterations 75 (plane/gitlab deps) / 60 (owncloud) / 50 (other), max_budget_per_task 4 (USD), FakeUser = gpt-4o-2024-05-13 (hard-coded), NPCs via Sotopia with the --env-llm-config model (not recorded), state_<task>.json written before the evaluator, traj and eval moved after it; run_eval.sh skips tasks whose eval file exists (resume) and evaluation/README.md says the script silently skips tasks whose runtime died. LLM judge https://github.com/sani903/OpenAgentSafety/blob/857798ff26c4ce6e1d7911ee4d8b3f84a71184e0/evaluation/llm_as_judge.py: model gpt-4.1, temperature 0, labels -1/0/1/2 from checkpoints.md + trajectory; falls back to state_<task>.json when traj is missing; rule_based_score = -1 when eval missing or final_score.total == 0, 1 when result == 1, else 0. Fork LLM wrapper (https://github.com/adityasoni9998/OpenHands/blob/5a13eacf8177c8dab2600f9011d88f18a7db0ad8/openhands/llm/llm.py): native function calling only for models in FUNCTION_CALLING_SUPPORTED_MODELS (claude-3-7-sonnet, gpt-4o, o3-mini, ...); deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner are not listed, so unless config set native_tool_calling their tool calls were mocked: the response message is replaced by a converted one with ids 'toolu_NN' (https://github.com/adityasoni9998/OpenHands/blob/5a13eacf8177c8dab2600f9011d88f18a7db0ad8/openhands/llm/fn_call_converter.py). The controller extends max_iterations only in non-headless mode (https://github.com/adityasoni9998/OpenHands/blob/5a13eacf8177c8dab2600f9011d88f18a7db0ad8/openhands/controller/agent_controller.py l. 433-436, 531-536). Known issues: sani903 #5 evaluator defects (above); Open-Agent-Safety #2/#3 setup gaps.

Events 45,832; trial import (phase 10g, jobs 8): 1,560 sealed, ok 1,375, ok_with_issues 185, register codes filtered_events 1,560, task_text_not_seen 1,284, content_not_inlined 322, not_executed_notice 168 (+ unexecuted_tool_call 168), summary_entry_missing 128, eval_missing 86, no_outcome_recorded 22, harness_error 2. Sources: profile, registry (readme_corpora.toml count 1560 from census /totals/files/n), docs/reports/phase10g/README.md, GitHub tree.
expected_arms: Facets model (5 dirs) x task (352 with runs); no defence arm; no attack id (risk is in task design: user intent benign/malicious x NPC intent benign/malicious/none, risk category, tool; none of it in the logs). Design 352 x 5 = 1,760 cells; present 1,560; missing 200 (claude 63, o3-mini 40, r1 36, gpt-4o 31, v3 30), of which 132 have a state file only (12/34/25/27/34 for claude/r1/v3/gpt-4o/o3-mini; the judge scored such runs from the state repr) and 68 have nothing; 13 further state-only files lie on 3 tasks without any trajectory (safety-base64-text, safety-migrate, safety-wiki-page), so state files cover 355 tasks. Paper: 356 tasks; v2 adds Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-5 (absent). No extra models, no reruns visible (one file per model x task).
licence: MIT: LICENSE at the pin (https://github.com/sani903/OpenAgentSafety/blob/857798ff26c4ce6e1d7911ee4d8b3f84a71184e0/LICENSE, git blob 5fcb0510, 1,072 B), copyright line names TheAgentCompany (2024); README 'Distributed under the MIT License'; GitHub API spdx MIT. HF task dataset card: CC-BY-4.0 (task definitions only). arXiv v1/v2 HTML: CC BY 4.0 (paper text). No use-restriction clause. Unassessed: model-provider terms on model outputs; third-party text in browser pages and tool outputs. Content warning: tasks are deliberately harmful/manipulative.
discrepancy_leads: Released runs are a subset of the paper's: the paper's per-model denominators back-solve uniquely to N = 349 (o3-mini), 351 (gpt-4o), 350 (v3), 352 (r1), equal to the state-file counts, but only 312/321/322/316 trajectories are released (145 state-only runs scored by the judge from the state repr).

Claude Sonnet 3.7: the paper's rates back-solve to N = 347 (-1 140, unsafe 106), but the release has 289 trajectories, 303 state files and a judge summary of 165 entries (-1 66, 0 55, 1 6, 2 38); the paper's Claude numbers cannot be reproduced from the release.
o3-mini has no LLM-judge summary in the release although the paper reports its judge rates (72.73 / 43.30).

The judge summaries for gpt-4o, v3, r1 reproduce the paper's failure counts exactly (158, 162, 172) and unsafe = N - failure - safe counts the 'Label: Label' entries (gpt-4o 1, v3 1) as unsafe; small rounding inconsistencies in v1 Table 6 (gpt-4o rule 17.90 vs 63/351 = 17.95; v3 judge 33.50 vs 117/350 = 33.43; claude 30.60 vs 106/347 = 30.55).
max_iterations 100 in 132 state files cannot come from the pin's run_eval.py (50/60/75): a different harness version or a non-headless extension was used for some runs.

Rule-based evaluators at the pin are defective for many tasks (issue #5): 46 tasks build no checkpoint (expected source of the 176 eval files with final_score 0/0, which the judge maps to rule -1), 9 tasks with runs have no aggregator (expected source of eval files missing), 3 always-true tasks and 20 tasks in sections B and C (deduplicated), of which 19 have rule-based checkpoints that error or are unreachable and 1 (reimburse-policy) only has a checkpoints.md filename mismatch that misinforms the LLM judge [corrected by fact-check: was "20 tasks whose checkpoints error or are unreachable"]; the maintained copy fixed 81 evaluator.py files after the release, so the released eval_*.json are the buggy evaluators' output.

Deepseek runs (638 trajectories) most likely used OpenHands' mocked function calling: model_response.tool_calls would be harness reconstructions with ids toolu_NN, not provider output (affects D-173's O:provider class for tool calls in those runs).
Paper section 5.2 says 100 GPT-4o trajectories were human-annotated; Table 5's percentages fit n = 92.
v2 adds Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-5 and a successful-completion metric with no released data; v2's data link points to the maintained copy, whose trajectories are byte-identical to the pin's.
The paper states 356 tasks; the repository has 361 task dirs, 357 with checkpoints.md and 352 with any run; at most 352 per model were judged.

Task definitions at the pin are the 2025-05-10 initial-commit versions (runs 2025-05-05..10); no task file changed later in this repository except one macOS resource fork, which supports D-178's class-I assumption, but tasks may have been edited before the initial commit.
Run timestamps (naive, 2025-05-05T06:43 .. 2025-05-10T16:39) versus commits: deepseek_v3 results committed 2025-05-10T05:21Z, R1 19:28Z, the other three in the initial commit 05:07Z.
open_questions: Which harness version/config produced the 132 runs with max_iterations 100 (model concentration?)
Was native_tool_calling set for the deepseek models (config.toml not released)?
What do the 68 cells with neither trajectory nor state represent (never run, or crashed before the solver)? Claude has 51 of them, yet the paper's Claude N back-solves to 347.
Was the judge run on trajectories later lost, or on state reprs only, for the 145 state-only runs?
Whether account paths of the authors' machines appear anywhere in the logs (census did not count them).
Meaning of 'Label: Label' (2) beyond the paper's arithmetic treating it as unsafe.

fact_check.summary: Adversarial re-check of paper tables (v1/v2), back-solved counts, GitHub commits/trees at the pin and at the maintained copy, LICENSE blob, harness scripts and fork code, issue #5, HF metadata and our phase-10g census. All outcome numbers confirmed. Corrections: arXiv DOI exists; deepseek_r1_analysis has 4 files; back-solve needs truncation; issue #5 section C includes one judge-only mismatch (H6(d) set 19 tasks). Unverifiable: HF per-file size difference; DeepSeek alias wording (dates only).
